content.title: About
content.content: Reduced‑sodium spaghetti sauce is a ready‑to‑use tomato‑based sauce seasoned with herbs and spices, containing only 0.3 g of salt per 100 g. It delivers the classic rich flavor of traditional pasta sauce while being suitable for those watching their sodium intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The sauce is made from 100 % natural tomatoes with no artificial colors or preservatives.
Salt reduction is achieved by enhancing flavor with basil, oregano and a touch of sugar.
Each batch is tested to ensure the sodium level does not exceed 0.3 g per 100 g.
Tomatoes provide lycopene, a powerful antioxidant.
The product is vegetarian and gluten‑free.

items.title: Low sodium content
items.content: Reduced salt helps maintain normal blood pressure and reduces kidney strain.

items.title: Rich in lycopene
items.content: Lycopene has antioxidant properties that support heart health.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: The sauce supplies vitamin C, vitamin A and potassium, which aid immune function and electrolyte balance.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Tomatoes are a source of dietary fiber that promotes regular bowel movements.

items.title: Low‑calorie
items.content: One tablespoon provides about 15 kcal, making it suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Tomato allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to tomatoes or the herbs used in the sauce.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: A small amount of sugar is added for balance; people with diabetes should account for it in their carbohydrate budget.

items.title: Acidic ingredients
items.content: The sauce contains citric acid, which can cause mild stomach irritation in sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Add the sauce to cooked spaghetti, other pasta, lasagna, or use it as a base for casseroles. It also works well as a dip for vegetables or as a flavorful dressing for salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened jar in a cool, dry place. Once opened, keep it refrigerated at 0 °C‑4 °C and consume within 5‑7 days. Do not freeze, as texture may change.
